identity.title: Mewtwo Strikes Back Evolution Music Collection

leadText:
----
 
Mewtwo Strikes Back Evolution Music Collection (Japanese: 「ミュウツーの逆襲 EVOLUTION」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the twenty-second movie. It was released in Japan on July 24, 2019 in two versions: Limited Edition and Regular Edition.

The Limited Edition box set includes a bonus disc containing a digital remaster of the soundtrack to the first movie, goods, a picture label, and a color booklet. The first print run of the Regular Edition includes a Pokémon sticker.
